name: io.github.FreeVectorIcons/fvi-mcp
title: FreeVectorIcons
description: Read and write a FreeVectorIcons design collection: briefs, DESIGN.md, icons and brand assets.

environmentVariables.name: FVI_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Collection-scoped token (fvi_col_…) from FreeVectorIcons → your collection → Integrations → Setup MCP. The collection is derived from this token. Never commit this value.

environmentVariables.name: FVI_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: API origin including /api. Leave the default for production.

environmentVariables.name: FVI_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set true to hide write tools (park, upload, version).
